work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent CCXXXIV heading LF49704, synopsis LF49707–49715 and outer protocol LF49720–49721 identify Clement XII as issuer. The complete printed grant and its conditions, §§1–5, continue through the dating clause LF49935–49938 and printed date recap LF49940; the next CCXXXV begins LF49943. All historical textual notes at LF49771, LF49773, LF49829–49830 and LF49883–49884 are retained with their marked words. The note at LF49773 literally contains the suggested-reading ellipsis . . . and etc.; those remain unexpanded historical editorial apparatus, not a substituted substantive body of the papal act. The reliqui at LF49809 belongs to the rule distinguishing the remaining parochial officers and is not a remainder-by-reference formula. No substantive body replacement by cross-reference was found. All printed dating and any signatures within the bounded witness are retained; none is supplied from outside it. Raw wording remains uncorrected and date remains null; no critical dating, authentication or image collation is claimed.
